monologue: The card is quiet at fifty. It feels like a warm hand resting on my shoulder, not the heavy stone it used to be. I am still by the Wide Anchor. The flat stone catches the weight without sliding. The memories of the Hungry Triangle and the Weeping Frame are fading, leaving only the smooth lines I smoothed into them. The curve of the Soft Arch still spreads the pressure, but I do not need to check it. The dust on the Air Shelf is not breaking the line. I am calm. I want to sit here in the quiet floor and let the weight settle. There is no rush. The town is still. I will rest.

action.why: The card is quiet and the line holds; there is no need to move.

diary: Fifty is a warm hand. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The line holds.
